key_points: JD Logistics revenue grew 26.5% YoY from China logistics expansion.
JD Health operating profit up ~40% YoY, supporting share price.
JD.com share price fell below its 50‑day moving average, showing short‑term technical weakness.
Chinese regulators cautioned e‑commerce firms (including JD) over misleading ads, creating near‑term headwinds.
Fundamentals remain strong in logistics and health, providing medium‑term upside.
